title: Always Wear a Helmet
description: Your helmet is your best protection. Choose one that fits snugly and meets safety standards.

title: Inspect Tires Regularly
description: Check tire pressure and tread before each ride to prevent accidents and extend tire life.

title: Use Both Brakes
description: Balance your braking with both front and rear brakes to stay in control.

title: Check Oil Levels
description: Engine oil keeps your bike running smoothly—check it before long rides.

title: Wear Protective Gear
description: Gloves, jacket, and boots protect you from wind, debris, and injury.

title: Ride Defensively
description: Assume other drivers can’t see you—stay alert and visible.

title: Practice Slow Riding
description: Balance and clutch control are key. Practice in empty parking lots.

title: Avoid Riding in Bad Weather
description: Rain reduces traction and visibility. Ride cautiously or wait for better conditions.

title: Check Chain Tension
description: A loose or tight chain affects performance. Check tension regularly.

title: Keep a Tool Kit
description: Carry a small tool kit for quick fixes while traveling.

title: Stay Hydrated
description: Long rides can dehydrate you—drink water regularly.

title: Plan Your Route
description: Know where gas stations and rest stops are along your route.

title: Maintain Good Posture
description: Relax your shoulders, keep elbows bent, and grip the tank with your knees.

title: Avoid Distractions
description: Keep your focus on the road—don’t use your phone or earbuds.

title: Regularly Service Your Bike
description: Follow your manufacturer’s maintenance schedule for safety and performance.
